tools.name: get_reference_price
tools.description: Price in EUR of one coin on 1 January 00:00 Dutch time (31 December 23:00 UTC) of the given year, per exchange platform. Omit platform to get all platforms. Includes candleTime and kind ("open" of that hour, or "close" of the last earlier hour) and the URL of the coin page.

tools.name: value_portfolio
tools.description: Value in EUR of a list of holdings on 1 January 00:00 Dutch time of the given year, using each holding's platform price. Returns value per line and the total. Lines without a price are marked missing and not counted. Also returns a link to the calculator. Nothing is stored.

tools.name: compare_platforms
tools.description: All six platforms side by side for one coin on 1 January 00:00 Dutch time of the given year, with missing platforms marked and the spread between lowest and highest price.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Every reference-date price (1 January 00:00 Dutch time) of one coin since the first year with data, per platform, with the percentage change versus the previous year on the same platform.

tools.name: search_coins
tools.description: Find coins by ticker, name or slug; tolerant of case and partial input ("eth", "bitc", "ripple"). Returns ticker, name, slug, platforms with a price in the latest year and the coin page URL.

tools.name: estimate_box3
tools.description: Indication of Dutch box 3 tax on crypto only, for tax years 2025 and 2026: tax-free allowance (doubled with a fiscal partner) → base → fixed deemed return for "other assets" → tax at the box 3 rate. tools.name: explain_box3
tools.description: Fixed, factual explanation (Dutch and English) of how crypto is valued for Dutch box 3: reference moment, which price to use, own wallets, actual return. With a link to the Belastingdienst. No amounts that change per year.
